$Classic Controller
*By quatric
*Punch-Out!! (USA) (R7PE01)
*Play with a Classic Controller: buttons mapped as a Wii Remote held sideways, the right stick steers the menu pointer.
*Needs a Wii Remote with a Classic Controller attached.
* extension check: let a Classic Controller take the Wii Remote path
041B0554 38000001
* pad update: Classic Controller buttons -> Wii Remote bits
